audit_log.note: One canonical audit log on every platform — audit-log.sh is home-relative and the schema is shared. Contract: docs/plans/cross-platform-compat.md, 'Audit log'.

command_naming.note: Each plugin installs into its own ~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>/ directory, so skill names are not prefixed. Evidence: docs/platform-matrix.md Item 1.

evidence.bundled_scripts: docs/platform-matrix.md — PR 2 re-verification, AGY_INSTALL_MODE: copy. A non-recognized scripts/ subdirectory is copied with the plugin, so bundled helpers ship.
evidence.config_root: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 1. Plugins install to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>/; the registry is ~/.gemini/config/import_manifest.json.
evidence.invocation: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 6. Skills are invoked with a /-prefixed skill name.
evidence.model_aliases: Claude's haiku/sonnet/opus aliases name no model on either target (docs/platform-matrix.md, 'Already measured': OpenCode models are provider-scoped strings and those three names do not exist; the Agy models measured in the Ledger are differently named). Prose that names one as a routing choice is mapped to a capability description instead, so no generated artifact asks for a model that cannot resolve.
evidence.no_model_field: Unmeasured. No matrix item establishes a per-skill model field for this platform, so none is emitted; model choice is passed at invocation (docs/platform-matrix.md Item 8 records that agy -p accepts --model).
evidence.no_version_field: docs/plans/cross-platform-compat.md — 'Versioning'. plugin.json carries name + description only so version-bump.yml can never desync dist/.
evidence.skill_frontmatter: docs/platform-matrix.md — 'Already measured' + Item 1. skills/*.md with name/description frontmatter become slash commands.
evidence.state_paths: The ~/.gemini/config/ root is matrix-derived (Item 1). The per-plugin subdirectory under it is plugin-owned state — writing our own file at a path of our choosing needs no platform capability, so it is not a platform claim.

pre_replacements.replace:
AUDIT_FILE="${AUDIT_LOG_FILE:-}"
# Tilde-expanded on assignment rather than interpolating the home variable, because no
# generated artifact may carry a machine path — see build/README.md, 'dist/ invariants'.
[ -n "$AUDIT_FILE" ] || AUDIT_FILE=~/.claude/audit.jsonl
pre_replacements.why: The bundled audit logger resolves its default path from the home variable. dist/ must contain no such reference, and tilde does not expand inside a quoted ${VAR:-...} default, so the default is resolved on a separate unquoted assignment instead.

evidence.command_dir: docs/platform-matrix.md — Items 3 and 5 (measured against ~/.config/opencode/commands/) plus the reconciliation note in docs/plans/cross-platform-compat.md section 0, which records that the bundled help documents both the singular and plural directory names.
evidence.frontmatter_agent: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 3. agent: <name> is honored and selects the subagent type.
evidence.frontmatter_argument_hint: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 3. argument-hint is informational only; its runtime effect was not isolated.
evidence.model_aliases: Claude's haiku/sonnet/opus aliases name no model on either target (docs/platform-matrix.md, 'Already measured': OpenCode models are provider-scoped strings and those three names do not exist). Prose that names one as a routing choice is mapped to a capability description instead, so no generated artifact asks for a model that cannot resolve.
evidence.no_model_field: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 3 measured only that Claude Code's model: convention is NOT honored; it explicitly did not rule out a differently-named OpenCode field. Emitting no model field is therefore a safe default, not a settled platform fact. Model choice is passed at invocation by the dispatch backend.
evidence.no_plugin_root: docs/platform-matrix.md — Item 0. A binary scan of the OPENCODE_* surface found no per-invocation 'this command's own path' variable, so bundled-script paths are resolved at install time by placeholder substitution.
evidence.state_paths: The ~/.config/opencode/ root and the project-local .opencode/ directory are matrix-derived ('Already measured' and Item 5). The per-plugin subdirectory under them is plugin-owned state — writing our own file at a path of our choosing needs no platform capability, so it is not a platform claim.
